name: pamoja-node-workspace
description: The Node binding workspace: the napi-rs crate at this directory, @pamoja/core with the compiled engine under packages/core, one @pamoja package per capability, and the pamoja bundle.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:facade
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --package-json-path packages/native/package.json --output-dir packages/native && npm run build:facade
